Name: CKM - Ridgeside Village
Author: Digus
Description:
[size=3][b]Current version: 1.0.0[/b][/size][list]
[*] [size=2]Adds all current Ridgeside Village romanceable NPCs.[/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=2]Have [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url] installed.[/size]
[*][size=2]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286/]Ridgeside Village[/url] installed.[/size]
[*][size=2]Habe [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4664/]Custom Kiss Mod[/url] installed.[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32573/]CKM - Ridgeside Village[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]How does it work[/b]:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]It adds a configuration to all [size=2]romanceable NPCs added by Ridgeside Village.[/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]If you don't change Custom Kissing Mod default configuration, you should be able to kiss the NPCs you are dating with, and have seen their 10th heart event.[/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]If you already configured any npc youself, their configuration will be ignored unless you enable "Content Pack Override".[/size][/size]
[*][size=2][size=2]You can also open the GMCM after loading this mod and save the config there. After doing that you can safely remove this content pack from your mods folder, since the configurations will be saved in the CKM config.json file. But if you do so, you will miss on any updates released for it, and if you ever reset CKM configuration, it will also wipe RSV npcs configuration.[/size][/size]
[/list][size=3][size=3][b]
[/b][/size][/size][size=3][b]Uninstall:[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=2]Delete the mod from the installation folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Clean CKM configuration if you saved it with GMCM.[/size]
[/list]
